chapters.label: Berlin, live
chapters.text: Berlin, 2024, the Euro final. Spain, in red, and England are level with four minutes left. Left-back Marc Cucurella has joined the attack. Oyarzabal passes to him and runs into the box. Cucurella crosses it low... Oyarzabal scores! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Cucurella drives it low, past Walker. Oyarzabal escapes his defender and gets there first.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: past Pickford! Spain win the final, two-one.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: defend first. Then, when your winger has the ball, run forward and join the attack.
